title: extract-anything envelope
description: One JSON envelope: the extracted contract plus an inline loss-bounding _meta block. The contract's inner shape is mode-dependent (conform => the caller's target_schema; infer => a minimal inferred shape), so it is intentionally left open here.

contract.description: The extracted, lean, downstream-facing payload. Shape per mode; validated against target_schema separately when conform mode is used.

source_ref.description: How to reach the original source (path, ref, or anchor) so dropped context is recoverable.

coverage.description: How much must-preserve content was captured.

confidence.description: Extractor confidence in the contract's fidelity to the source.

dropped.description: Every intentional omission. Silent loss is forbidden.

provenance.description: Per non-obvious contract field, where in the source it came from.
